CHIEF DESIGN OFFICER

A studio built around
the work.

The Red Studio brings brand design, digital products, graphics, motion and sound into one conversation. Shubham Jain is the Founder. Rajiv Priyadarshi is the Chief Design Officer.

We start with what you need to communicate and who needs to understand it. Then we choose the right format: an identity, a useful interface, a campaign, or something that moves and sounds.

Named collaborators, visible decisions, and organised handoffs are part of the approach. The work should make sense when you ask why.

What we hold
the work to.

A reason for each choice.

Type, colour, motion and sound should serve the brief. Review the direction with the thinking behind it.

People can use it.

Readability, keyboard access, responsive layouts and reduced motion belong in the design conversation.

Authorship stays visible.

Discuss sources, usage rights and any AI assistance. Review the final work for originality, relevance and accuracy.
